issue_context.title: VXL hover units slide when turn around
issue_context.body: We have already discussed the aircraft pitch and roll by using the new system of VXL,  so how about make hover tank slide too?  In mission movie the hover MRLS can slide when turn around and it is kinda cool.  Since the hover units VXL aren't affect by ramp so maybe we can try this and see if it will turn out to be a cool idea.

review_comments: This means that a unit won't finish turning if its turn speed is so slow that it can't turn before the move activity finished. I'm not sure if that is intended. (Testcase: Give the Hover MRLS a turn speed of 7 or 1 if you want a more extreme example.)
I think it makes sense. If you don't need to turn you don't turn. The purpose of the move activity it to move the target, and turning is merely a means to an end.

Yes, I'm not sure because of that either. However, as is the player has basically no way to turn a unit with a slow turn rate and this setting enabled without sending it over a long distance. (Which could be quite annoying with units that need to face to attack.) An extra turn activity after finishing the movement probably wouldn't be a problem.
In the case of docking, it would look weird for an actor to first turn to the movement facing and then turn to the docking facing. Same with queued up deploy.

One could argue that an actor that can turn while moving should slide into position during docking anyway, so this sounds more like an issue with the target facing for the docking activity. In the end I don't really care either way until we have a practical usecase.
when thinking of TD or TS refineries you really need to slide at the correct angle. Otherwise it will both look weird and won't matchup with the refinery model
